problems.title: Assign Cookies
problems.notes: sort both arrays, two-pointer greedy match — the simplest possible greedy exchange-argument warm-up

problems.title: Jump Game
problems.notes: track the farthest reachable index greedily in one pass — no need to actually simulate every jump path

problems.title: Jump Game II
problems.notes: BFS-flavored greedy: expand the current 'level's' farthest reach, incrementing jumps only when you must

problems.title: Gas Station
problems.notes: if total gas >= total cost a solution exists; greedy reset-start-on-deficit finds it in one linear pass

problems.title: Partition Labels
problems.notes: greedy window sizing using each character's last-occurrence index — close a partition once you've passed every last-index in it

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II
problems.notes: sum every positive day-over-day price delta — proving this equals the optimal multi-transaction profit is the interview bar

problems.title: Queue Reconstruction by Height
problems.notes: sort by height descending then k ascending, insert each person at index k — insertion order is the greedy insight

problems.title: Task Scheduler
problems.notes: closed-form greedy using the most-frequent-task count and idle slots, or simulate directly with a max-heap

problems.title: Candy
problems.notes: two greedy passes (left-to-right, then right-to-left), take the max of both passes at each position
